problems: The camera the card names is almost invisible. It sits right under the shell, and the body and the front-right rotor hide it. Only a black sliver shows and the blue lens can't be seen.

The camera angle hides the underside: the 18° elevation plus the forward tip shows the top and hides the camera. Lower the camera to 10° elevation and reduce the tip. Move the azimuth to 22° so the front-right rotor no longer lines up in front of the camera.

The camera lens doesn't read as blue. The glass finish renders almost black inside the black bezel, so the brief's 'small blue camera lens' is lost. Use a gloss blue lens that fills more of the bezel.

At 10 degrees elevation, the flat drone shows almost none of its round top. The body reads as a thin sliver. Raise the elevation a little and tip the drone a bit more toward the camera so the round white body and rotor discs show.
